title: Requirement-to-Evidence Signoff Model
description: Execute closure decisions using owned artifacts, configuration tags, last-regression evidence, zero-hit remediation, and independently reviewed waivers.
learnerQuestion: What makes a checklist item auditable evidence rather than an unsupported check mark?

configurations.label: Nightly legal regression
configurations.description: Protocol-clean traffic, assertions, coverage, and evidence publication.

configurations.label: Waiver review
configurations.description: A justified unreachable or out-of-scope item requires owner and independent reviewer.

scenarios.label: Close with correlated evidence
scenarios.description: A requirement closes only when its stimulus, checker, coverage, and immutable result artifact agree for the selected configuration.

steps.label: Collect
steps.event: Nightly regression publishes checker and coverage artifacts

checks.label: Checker passed
checks.evidence: The result is linked to the same configuration as the requirement.

checks.label: Required scenario hit
checks.evidence: Coverage records that the prerequisite and backpressure scenarios actually executed.

checks.label: Evidence-backed terminal status
checks.evidence: Owner, configuration, artifact URI, regression date, and reviewer are retained together.

scenarios.label: Zero-hit bin remediation
scenarios.description: A legal zero-hit bin maps to a concrete test scenario; it is not converted to ignore merely to improve the percentage.

steps.label: Detect hole
steps.event: Legal WRAP × backpressure × final ERROR bin has zero hits

checks.label: Zero-hit bin has scenario
checks.evidence: The closure plan names stimulus rather than hiding a reachable legal hole.

checks.label: Legal bin remains legal
checks.evidence: Configuration-derived legality cannot be changed for a desired metric.

steps.label: Rerun
steps.event: Mapped test hits the bin and checker passes

checks.label: Coverage hole closed
checks.evidence: Closure includes checker correlation, not a hit count alone.

checks.label: Checker correlates with hit
checks.evidence: The test did not reach the bin by violating another obligation.

scenarios.label: Unreviewed waiver rejection
scenarios.description: A waiver without a rationale, owner, configuration, and independent reviewer is not terminal evidence.

steps.label: Reject waiver
steps.event: Owner marks a zero-hit legal bin waived without review

checks.label: Incomplete waiver cannot close
checks.evidence: The signoff model flags missing configuration, rationale, and reviewer.
